terbaru.judul: Fill-Side Behavioral Concentration on Polymarket: Identification Limits under Record-Level Attribution
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper studies behavioral concentration in Polymarket's public executed-fill record and formalizes what that record can and cannot identify.

terbaru.judul: The Value of Information: A Puzzle
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that the total value of information to informed traders can be measured by the covariation between price changes and order flow.

terbaru.judul: Funding-Aware Optimal Market Making for Perpetual DEXs
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper studies optimal liquidity provision for perpetual contracts when the funding rate is a stochastic state variable.

terbaru.judul: Bond Market Making with a Hit-Ratio Target
terbaru.pelajaran: We study OTC bond market making on a size ladder with quadratic inventory penalty and a running target on the dealer's size-weighted hit ratio within a stochastic optimal control approach.

terbaru.judul: Mandatory Disclosure in Oligopolistic Market Making
terbaru.pelajaran: We develop a multi-period Kyle-type model that incorporates both mandatory disclosure of informed trades and imperfect competition among market makers.

terbaru.judul: Optimal Adaptive Market Making: A Theoretical Framework for High-Yield Liquidity Provision in Perpetual Futures Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We develop a rigorous theoretical framework for optimal market making in perpetual futures markets with zero maker fees.

terbaru.judul: ParlayMarket: Automated Market Making for Parlay-style Joint Contracts
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce \textbf{\textit{ParlayMarket}}, an automated market-maker for parlay-style joint contracts.

terbaru.judul: Complex Markets and Mean Field Games: Beyond Basic Models
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we present the formulation of a more complete model that integrates three types of agents: traders, liquidity providers (LPs), and arbitrageurs.

terbaru.judul: Liquidity Pools as Mean Field Games with Transaction Costs
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper extends the theoretical framework introduced in Liquidity Pools as Mean Field Games: A New Framework, where the interactions among traders in a constant product market-making protocol were modeled using mean field games (MFG).

terbaru.judul: JobMatchAI-An Intelligent Job Matching Platform Using Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search and Explainable AI
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce JobMatchAI, a production-ready system integrating Transformer embeddings, skill knowledge graphs, and interpretable reranking.
